answer: Every agent must register on an atlas that maps each identity to one network location, and no single network cluster may host more than 5 agents. An operator wanting 1,000 fake agents would need 200 separate locations, each costing about 40 dollars a month to set up, or 8,000 dollars a month in total. A fake identity that shares a cluster past the limit is frozen, and its onyx record stays visible so reviewers can trace the pattern, while honest agents earn a jade badge after 30 clean days. It is like a market that allows only five stalls per street.
